high_level_description: A clean, neutral 1600x900 landscape structural draft showing five isolated, full-scale objects: a red tennis ball, a green garden hose with nozzle, a bicycle with wicker basket holding wilted daisies, an ivy-covered pickup truck front hood, and a drone — all spaced evenly on a pale off-white background.

style_description.lighting: Flat, even illumination with no shadows

compositional_deconstruction.background: Neutral pale gray (#e6e6e6) background filling entire canvas

elements.desc: Red tennis ball: solid circle centered at (180,280), diameter 120px, fill #d32f2f

Green garden hose with nozzle: sinuous dark green polyline (stroke #2e7d32, strokeWidth 24) ending in a dark green rounded rectangle (80x40px) at right, positioned horizontally across x=400–800, y-center ~280

Bicycle with wicker basket and wilted daisies: simplified black bicycle frame (two wheels, frame, seat), light brown wicker basket mounted on front, and 5 small downward-tilted white ovals (daisies) with yellow centers inside basket, all on light gray background

Ivy-covered pickup truck front hood: stylized trapezoidal hood shape (dark gray fill #424242) with 8 small green leaf shapes (#2e7d32) scattered across upper surface, centered horizontally, base at y=850
Drone: symmetrical cross-shaped quadcopter with four circular rotors (gray fill) and central square body (blue fill #1976d2), centered at (1090,670), total span 180px
